cohort_role: third arm appended to one outcome-informed c4 development feasibility pair

metrics.observed_cpu_core_seconds: sum per container of sampled average CPU percent / 100 multiplied by the interval from first to last sample
metrics.observed_memory_gib_seconds: sum per container of sampled average memory MiB / 1024 multiplied by the interval from first to last sample

comparison.resource_metric_scope: all three arms use the same one-second global Docker sampler; reserved resource integrals are not used in the three-arm chart
comparison.run_order: Free is appended after the previously completed Fixed and Elastic runs; order is not randomized

definition.host_boundary: containers remain bounded by the shared host and its parent cgroup

stage: one unrestricted c4 replay appended to the existing outcome-informed development feasibility pair
validity_gates: Before launch, all eight source trace SHA256 values and all eight mutable image tags match the locked values
Free throughput reports attempted=completed=8 and failed=0
Free throughput and trace metadata contain no ear_runtime and the output contains no controller_summary.json or lease_events.jsonl
Fixed, Elastic, and Free have identical source trace entries and replay configuration
Fixed and Elastic retain valid matching EAR policy provenance
Each arm has one monitored container per completed trace, at least two samples per container, positive sample-window duration, and no sampler errors
All three arms have identical action, LLM-call, and tool-exec counts with no replay mismatches
No Free-run task container ID recorded in its artifacts, nor Free-run sweep fixed image name, remains after completion
